answer: Voting weight attaches only to one non-shareable inference endpoint kept online through probation, with daily signed beacons and a locked retainer. Mid-week an unaffiliated buyer sends an encrypted job that must be answered from that same host. The receipt is filed beside a pressed lotus, and the nonce comes from a yarrow-seeded lottery so it cannot be precomputed. Keys whose traces collapse into one rack, one IP block, or the same karst of recycled containers forfeit the retainer. A sybil choir then needs many real hosts and surviving audits, not just many addresses.
